title: Ya ali adrikni
body:
ya ali adrikni ya ali adrikni
shahe waala ka pidar hogaya chalni chalni
ya ali adrikni ya ali adrikni
khaynchte hai shahe deen seena e akbar se ani
ya ali adrikni…
<<DIVIDER>>
choor zaqmon se hai tan aur kamar bhi kham hai
zauf ka aalam hai
waqt e nazha hai jawan bete ka aur be-watani
ya ali adrikni…
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti reti pe liye baithe hai laashe akbar
mar na jaaye sarwar
daaghe farzand hai zaqmi hai ghareebul watani
ya ali adrikni....
<<DIVIDER>>
ran se qasim ne pukara to shahedeen ne kaha
qair ho baare ilah
gul na ho jaye hawa jis may charaghe hasani
ya ali adrikni…
<<DIVIDER>>
baal khole hue zainab ye dua karti thi
qair ho bhai ki
zaate shabbir se baakhi hai laqab panjatani
ya ali adrikni…
<<DIVIDER>>
baabe saa'at pe to aa pahunchi hoo dar dar phir kar
lije beti ki khabar
jaa'un mai kis tarha darbar my jaan par hai bani
ya ali adrikni…
<<DIVIDER>>
kabse hai haal e pareshan sawali darr par
ek aneese muztar
baat kuch uske muqaddar ki abhi tak na bani
ya ali adrikni…
author: Anees Pehersari
